response.overview: ‘The Confession’ is a new VRChat Short Film that’s a 1940s Noir-style film. It’s a short story that involves the main character (Hoku) confessing to Mellow about the circumstances that happened with his brother (Cain) and the murder of his best friend (Ben); all the while not understanding the trueness of forgiveness and letting go. Will he learn to forgive?
response.title: The Confession
